# config

Back to the [README](../README.md).

`providers.real.example.json` shows the settings format. The app saves your own settings to `providers.json`, which stays out of git. Most people never edit this by hand: use **Providers** in the app, as described in [PROVIDERS.md](../docs/PROVIDERS.md).

API keys never go here. They belong in `.env`, and the settings store only the variable's name.
